coordinateSystem.origin: center of reserved site on flat ground
coordinateSystem.blenderConversion: Blender (x,y,z)=(x,z,y), front -Y; orient face winding outward. Verify FBX handedness and apply expected yaw 180 before camera-facing wrapper.

materials.waterPreview: Flat schematic blue and stream ribbons only; actual shader not rendered/tested in this proposal.

foundation.placementSlope: level pad, maximum ground excursion 0.08m; reject/level unsuitable terrain before apply

futureIntegration.migration: Preserve existing saved fish and pond IDs. Legacy Lv4 migrates to Lv3; over-capacity ponds allow withdrawal but no further deposits until count <= capacity. No silent deletion.
futureIntegration.autoFeeding: Separate auto feeder from production FeedMaker; recipe timing, hopper stock, daily consumption and save fields need implementation after approval.
futureIntegration.footprint: Definition currently has one footprint. With current system reserve largest 20x16 m for all levels; per-level 14x11/16x13/20x16 requires upgrade-expansion checks.
futureIntegration.swim: Replace fixed radius 0.32m / Y0.05 with the approved inner polygon, deck exclusion and Y0.38..0.50 band; normalize actual fish prefab bounds to length 0.45..0.90m and vertical thickness <=0.18m.

performance.staticMeshes: One combined opaque static mesh per LOD; one separate main water mesh, maximum two static renderers/materials at a time.
performance.machines: Station components and simple colliders on empty child markers; static casing stays in combined mesh.
performance.waterFx: Reuse existing pack particles at 1/2 inlet and one outlet; near-camera effect budget, not baked transparent geometry.
performance.fish: 8/12/18 representative visible fish, independent from 50/100/250 logical fish capacity; pool and use actual ItemSO.worldPrefab.

referenceNote: Images 1 and 2 have the same pictured form. Lv2 enlargement + auto feeder follows user text. Rear/hidden details are designed proposals.
